top_signals.title: Dockworkers Strike Against Arms Shipments at More Than 100 Ports Globally
top_signals.summary: Dockworkers in 22 countries will strike on Friday, protesting against war and the use of ports for arms exports in action organisers say could disrupt over 40% of Mediterranean cargo and snarl over $2 billion worth of freight.The strike, originally called by dockworkers' unions in Italy…
